notes: Domain status supports enabled and disabled waits.

Refresh and preload queries document terminal states but captured rows omit task_id, so an exact task selector cannot be verified. URL can recur across submissions and is not treated as a unique task identity.
Block and unblock queries accept only arrays of task IDs, URLs or submission IDs. They cannot provide one required scalar selector.
Compilation and staging results span multiple edge nodes, without an explicit node input or documented overall terminal state; no first-row or nonempty-list success is inferred.

response_notes: Batch domain operations expose each domain code and message; their outer successful envelope does not guarantee all domain outcomes succeeded.
The script configuration example contains invalid JSON string escapes; the explicit statusCode 100000 schema supports the command without fabricating a fixture or changing the script.

request_notes: Report subscription timestamps, task lookup selectors and unblock inputs follow documented conditional requirements and defaults.

Domain creation still accepts upstream action 2, whose modification behavior is scheduled for shutdown; help directs modification to cdn domain update. The still-supported creation action is not marked deprecated.
GET domain ownership verification is a state-changing operation and requires confirmation without retries.

Condition maps are documented as Map of String but both schema descriptions and captured examples contain arrays of condition objects. They use Object input to preserve nested values; genuine string-valued origin host maps retain their original type.
